title: One line of the capability changelog
description: changelog/<yyyy-mm>.jsonl holds one JSON object per line, appended, never rewritten. Every change to an item, the registry or the schema gets one line.

at.description: When, ISO 8601 with the local offset.

by.description: Who: a consumer id from registry.json (the owner is 'runtime-bridge').

kind.description: added, removed or retired: an item came or went. stage, evidence, health, priority: that axis changed (give from and to). demand: a consumer's demand entry changed. issue: a known issue opened, changed or closed. detail: any other field. registry: areas, consumers or vocabularies. schema: the schema itself.

items.description: The item ids the change touches.

from.description: The previous value, for an axis change.

to.description: The new value, for an axis change.

summary.description: One plain sentence a reader can follow without the diff.
